# appgatesdp_ip_pool (Data Source)

Supported SDP Admin API versions: v21, v22, v23, v24, v25.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) ID of the object.
- `name` (String) Name of the object.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Create date.
- `currently_used` (Number) Number of IPs in the pool are currently in use by device&users.
- `excluded_ranges` (Attributes List) List of IP address ranges to exclude from the IP pool. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--excluded_ranges))
- `ip_version6` (Boolean) Whether the IP pool is for v4 or v6.
- `lease_time_days` (Number) Number of days Allocated IPs will be reserved for device&users before they are reclaimable by others.
- `notes` (String) Notes for the object. Used for documentation purposes.
- `ranges` (Attributes List) List of (non-conflicting) IP address ranges to allocate IPs in order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ranges))
- `read_only` (Boolean) Whether the entity is protected from manual updates and deletes. Supported in API versions: v24, v25.
- `reserved` (Number) Number of IPs in the pool are not currently in use but reserved for device&users according to the "leaseTimeDays" setting.
- `tags` (List of String) Array of tags.
- `total` (Number) The total size of the IP Pool.
- `updated` (String) Last update date.

### Nested Schema for `excluded_ranges`

Read-Only:

- `first` (String) The beginning of the IP range.
- `last` (String) The end of the IP range.

### Nested Schema for `ranges`
